title: What if
subtitle: See what paying more would change.

field.name: Scenario name
field.instalmentAmountHelp: Capital plus interest, excluding any servicing fee. Use this when the lender charges a payment that its own rate and term do not imply — a variable annuity is struck at a reset and then held, so it often reflects a rate that has since moved.

effect.SHORTEN_TERM_help: Your instalment stays the same and the loan ends earlier. Saves the most interest.
effect.LOWER_PAYMENT_help: The end date stays the same and your instalment drops. Saves less interest but frees up monthly cash.

event.empty: No changes yet. Add one to see the effect.

holiday.PAY_help: The balance stays where it is.
holiday.CAPITALISE: Add the interest to the balance
holiday.CAPITALISE_help: Costs more overall, because you then pay interest on that interest.

insight.shortenBeatsLower: Finishing sooner saves {{amount}} more interest than lowering the instalment.
insight.perUnit: Every {{unit}} you overpay saves {{saved}} in interest.
insight.breakEven: From {{period}} you have spent less in total than you would have without overpaying.
insight.breakEvenPeak: Before then you are up to {{amount}} further out of pocket.
insight.noBreakEven: This scenario never costs less in total than doing nothing.
insight.overpaymentNotACost: An extra payment is not money lost — it clears principal you owed anyway. Only the interest it avoids is a saving.
